reasons: Cited Section 9.9 contains all material terms of the preferred position: express frequency cap per Calendar Year, advance written notice, an independent auditor of international prominence reasonably acceptable to the audited Party, confidentiality undertakings limiting disclosure to the payment discrepancy, and auditing-Party-bears-cost unless underpayment exceeds a stated percentage.

No right of direct or remote access to Customer systems appears — the walk-away scenario is absent; scope is limited to books and records under Section 9.8 with a defined look-back and stale-claim waiver.
The clause is fully reciprocal, so it does not disadvantage our party; tightening it would equally cut back our own audit rights, supporting the no-redline recommendation.

Failed 'audit frequency limited' deterministic check is a phrasing/redaction artifact: the limit is present ('shall not occur more than [***] in a given Calendar Year') but the numeric value is redacted, so the regex cannot match.

Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or comment was proposed; the rationale correctly notes the redacted parameters, the 'unless for cause' exception and the missing business-hours language as sub-elements to confirm rather than deviations.
